sub: What to write, section by section

steps.title: Title and summary
points: Use a plain title: Marketing Intern
Two lines on the team and the goal
Say how long the internship runs
steps.tip: Skip jargon like ninja or rockstar. Students search plain titles.

steps.title: What they will do
steps.q: young woman planning social media content
points: Help plan a campaign or event
steps.tip: Five or six real tasks is plenty.

steps.title: What they will learn
points: Name the tools they will use
Mention a project they will own
steps.tip: This is the part students read most closely.

steps.title: How to apply
steps.tip: Give a closing date and stick to it.

cta_title: Ready to write your job description?
cta_sub: Copy the structure, add your details, post it.

captions.linkedin:
Writing a marketing intern job description? Use this structure.

1. Title and summary: a plain title students actually search for
2. What they will do: five or six real tasks
3. Skills you need: must-haves split from nice-to-haves
4. What they will learn: tools, mentor, a project they own
5. How to apply: hours, dates, location, closing date

Save it for when you next hire.
